PostToolUse.command: for d in "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins"/*/self-learning-memory "$HOME/.vscode/agent-plugins"/*/*/*/plugins/self-learning-memory; do if [ -x "$d/hooks/scripts/log-lesson.sh" ]; then exec "$d/hooks/scripts/log-lesson.sh"; fi; done; true

ErrorOccurred.command: for d in "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins"/*/self-learning-memory "$HOME/.vscode/agent-plugins"/*/*/*/plugins/self-learning-memory; do if [ -x "$d/hooks/scripts/log-lesson.sh" ]; then exec "$d/hooks/scripts/log-lesson.sh"; fi; done; true

SessionStart.command: for d in "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins"/*/self-learning-memory "$HOME/.vscode/agent-plugins"/*/*/*/plugins/self-learning-memory; do if [ -x "$d/hooks/scripts/inject-lessons.sh" ]; then exec "$d/hooks/scripts/inject-lessons.sh"; fi; done; true
